name: Address
purpose: Shows a person's name and postal address, such as who a vehicle is registered to, or who holds a driving licence.

origin.notes: The app's addressView in VehicleDetailView, under Registered to, and in DrivingLicenceSummaryView, on the licence: the name in Body Semibold, 8pt over the address's lines in Body, each line a paragraph of its own. The future driving designs keep it.

name.description: The person's name, in bold above the address, such as Mrs Jane Bloggs. Leave it off for an address alone.

inputs.content:
The address's lines, each on a line of its own, or separated by
. Blank lines and indents are left out, so they can be written however reads best in the HTML.

rules: Write the name and address as the service holds them: the app shows DVLA's records as they are, which may be in capitals.
Put each part of the address on a line of its own, ending with the postcode.
Give it a heading that says whose address it is and why, such as Registered to.
Don't show an address the user hasn't proved is theirs, such as in a vehicle check for any vehicle.

other.title: The app prototyping system's registered-to, which this follows (app-prototyping-system, exploration-2/components/registered-to)

references.description: Registered to, on a vehicle's detail screen, in light mode
A driving licence's holder, on the licence

examples.name: A name and address
examples.html:

</govuk-app-address>

examples.name: Under a heading, as Registered to
examples.html:
